gloss: The brightness that stays in a room after the lamp is out.
note: A faint concept of your own. Import more like this.

gloss: A mark for the sentence you will return to.
example: She left a redthread on the page.
note: A private symbol. You do not have to explain it.

gloss: The structure of a silence that still belongs to the sentence.
example: The held-pause did more than the answer.
note: An unspoken framework. It works even if you never name it.
